title: All-hands Oct 2026 - product & strategy update (draft)
content:
Audience: All employees
Owner: Taylor Lee (Product) - draft for exec review
Status: rough draft - need final numbers from Finance and SRE

Topline (one-liner for CEO): This quarter we launched Private GA, moved 3 enterprise customers onto Dedicated Reserved pools, and cut median latency for open-model workloads by ~18% through runtime kernel tuning and smarter batching.

Opening (30-60s)
- Quick thank-you to eng, infra, support - ops-heavy quarter.
- Frame: product + reliability focus; why this matters for customers (cost predictability, compliance, latency).

Key announcements (bullet highlights for slides)
1) Private GA (general availability) - production rollout
   - What: Private control plane is GA for VPC deployments + on-prem package (support + compliance add-on).
   - Why it matters: Enables regulated customers to run inference with Redwood-managed control plane and their own network boundaries.
   - Impact: 3 signed contracts in Q4 pilot (banking + healthcare), pipeline for 8 more.
   - Ask: Customer-facing teams - update sales/solutions one-pager; Legal to finalize contract template (see linked Confluence).

2) Dedicated: capacity & autoscale improvements
   - What: New reserved pool configs (CXL-backed instances + burst lanes) and improved autoscaling heuristics.
   - Metrics: Customers on Dedicated saw 12% higher throughput under peak and 7% lower cost per 1M tokens for typical chat workloads.
   - Ops note: Rollout will be staged next 2 weeks; SRE runbook updated (linked).

3) Redwood Optimize (beta) - public beta next month
   - Features: intelligent batching suggestions, quantization profile recommendations, model routing simulations.
   - Early wins: internal experiments show up to 28% cost reduction for retrieval-heavy traffic.
   - Beta signups: product/solutions to target 50 customers for Q4 beta.

4) Console & UX updates
   - Rolled out token-level cost breakdown, model rollouts UI (canary/A-B), and better traces for per-route latency.
   - Next: add alerting tied to eval regressions (work in progress).

Safety & reliability update
- Median latency improvement: ~18% for our open-model stack (kernel selection + continuous batching), P99 still work in progress for long-context workloads.
- Incident recap: brief note on 2026-09-18 outage - root cause = scheduler bug under burst; fixed, and mitigation applied (auto-fallback to warm pools).

People & org notes (if CEO wants to call out)
- Hires: shipped senior SRE, senior infra eng onboarded in Sept.
- Rotations: product-design lead moving to console & rollouts.

Customer stories / social proof
- BankCorp pilot: moved to Private pilot - 2-week onboarding, positive security review; quote pending.
- HealthAI: using Optimize suggestions - estimated 22% cost drop, early case study draft in progress.

Slides / deck flow suggestion (for slides team)
- Slide 1: Headline + topline metric (Private GA, latency improvement)
- Slide 2: Why this quarter mattered (context)
- Slide 3: Product announcements (4 bullets: Private GA, Dedicated improvements, Optimize beta, Console)
- Slide 4: Metrics - graphs (latency, cost per token, Dedicated throughput)
- Slide 5: Customer examples + callouts
- Slide 6: Roadmap next 90 days + asks from org
- Slide 7: Q&A prep

Q&A (anticipated) - suggested answers / notes
Q: What does Private GA pricing look like?
A: Still finalizing - baseline platform fee + per-region control-plane fee + typical Dedicated or usage pricing. Finance is modeling 3 pricing tiers; target to publish after legal sign-off (ETA 10/10).

Q: Will Private GA affect Hosted API roadmap?
A: No - Hosted API remains core PLG funnel. Private is additional enterprise offering; engineering investments are shared where possible.

Q: How do fallback policies affect model quality?
A: Fallbacks choose compatible variants with guardrails; we track quality regressions with evals and automatic rollbacks. We'll share examples in follow-up.

Q: Are there layoffs or org-wide cuts?
A: No. We are prioritizing targeted hires for infra and SRE. Keep messaging tight.

Notes to self / TODOs before final release
- Get final Q3 numbers from Finance (ARR impact, contract values) - action: Asha
- Confirm customer quote from BankCorp - action: Lucas
- Add P99 latency graph and short incident timeline - action: SRE (Maya)
- Legal to review Private GA contract template - action: Legal (tagged in Confluence)
- PR for slides deck: draft deck by 10/02 for exec review

Slack & refs
- Draft announcement thread (internal-comm): https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C01ABCDEF/p1695600000000
- Confluence: Private GA launch plan (linked above)
- Linear: PROD-1987 (Private GA launch checklist)

Styling notes for comms team
- Tone: technical but accessible - emphasize customer impact and reliability wins.
- Length: 2-3 short paragraphs + bullets; link to longer doc for details.
- Call-to-action: update customer-facing collateral; flag any sensitive details to Legal.

End of draft - open items flagged.

(Notes to self: keep some optional backup slides ready: deeper incident timeline, cost modeling chart, and a short tech slide about kernel-selection improvement with before/after numbers.)
